project.name: StateAction.ai · Collection & review MVP
project.summary: Reliable mobile MCAP upload, cloud CPU hand processing, internal clip review and authorized customer dataset inspection.
project.outcome: A repair worker can reliably upload a two-hour recording; our team reviews automatic 21-point hand clips and assigns approved data to datasets; authorized robotics customers inspect the same real viewer.
inScope: Flutter mobile app and recorder/SDK in one monorepo
Node.js/TypeScript Next.js API/auth/UI and Render workflow controllers
Better Auth Google login, minimal account Settings and sign-out
Direct resumable MCAP multipart upload to private R2
Official Render local runner and the same local/Modal CPU processing core
Mandatory 21 image hand landmarks with explicitly model-relative 3D estimates
Staff Pipeline recording details and recording-filtered clip review
Atomic approval/assignment, approved-only many-to-many datasets and manual customer grants
Real shared Rerun viewer and customer read-only inspection
Bounded cloud CPU canary, failure recovery, resource/cost measurements and field pilot qualification
outOfScope: Frozen dataset versions, publication, archive export and customer Download all (F1 follow-up)
Cloud GPU, WiLoR/MANO/FLORA production models or automatic GPU upgrades
Cosmos Curator, Ray, Lance, semantic captions/search/deduplication
Generic DAG/outbox/extra workflow engine, independent validator or second API
Per-joint correction, validated metric trajectories, robot actions or demonstrated training benefit
successEvidence: Clean-clone builds and real official-runner local E2E
Real Google/session/device ownership and interrupted multipart recovery
Mandatory CPU hand inference, native frame mapping, reader/checksum round trip and safe real RRD
Atomic approval/membership race proofs and actual cross-customer isolation
Real provider recovery/closure/cancellation and isolated restore drill
Measured representative two-hour resource/time/byte/cost receipt plus repair-footage usefulness pass
Accountable internal/customer UAT and explicit pilot go/no-go

management.ticketStateIntent: Backlog until triaged; only dependency-free work may be promoted to Todo after owner/capacity review.
management.assignmentPolicy: Do not guess individual assignees. ownerRole states the required discipline; assign one accountable person before starting.
management.datePolicy: Milestone order and dependency edges are commitments to sequence, not invented calendar deadlines. Add target dates only after capacity/estimates are confirmed.
management.sizePolicy: S/M are relative planning sizes, not elapsed-time promises or native Linear points; calibrate to the team estimate scale before sprint commitment. Split a ticket if it no longer has one reviewable outcome.
management.priorityPolicy: 1=High for early feasibility, current foundations, integrity/recovery or launch gates; 2=Normal for other required MVP work. Required scope alone does not make an issue High. No artificial Urgent tickets.
management.workflow: Backlog -> Todo -> In Progress -> In Review -> Done, mapped to existing team statuses; blocked work records native dependencies rather than a fabricated progress state.
definitionOfReady: One accountable assignee, understood dependencies and sufficient input fixtures/access.
Acceptance criteria and evidence method reviewed; open technical/product decisions have a named resolver.
No unresolved source-migration conflict or unapproved paid activation.
definitionOfDone: Acceptance criteria demonstrated with linked meaningful test/measurement evidence.
Code/config reviewed; contract/permission/failure cases relevant to the change pass.
Docs/runbooks and source/model/config provenance updated; no secret or raw private payload leakage.
Completion is implementation evidence, never a design document or synthetic mock alone.
management.cadence: Triage weekly and before committing work. Review milestone exits against evidence; publish a concise weekly project update with outcomes, next work, blockers/owners and measured cost/quality risks.
management.followUp: F1 whole-dataset release/export/download stays in the charter as a separate future increment and does not inflate this MVP project completion.
management.dependencyPolicy: Native blocked-by edges represent immediate prerequisites; omit redundant transitive edges. Milestones describe exit gates, not barriers that prevent early feasibility work in parallel.

milestones.name: M0 · Reproducible foundations
milestones.exitGate: A clean clone builds the mobile, web, jobs and Python packages; versioned contracts, database constraints and the official Render local runner are reproducible. No production services are assumed.

milestones.name: M1 · Authenticated, resumable collection
milestones.exitGate: Real console/mobile identities and owner-bound journals work. Closed MCAP and required sidecars upload directly through the sealed multipart protocol; interruption and account changes preserve ownership and bytes.

milestones.name: M2 · Local CPU processing
milestones.exitGate: A short real recording passes the official local workflow into mandatory hand inference, bounded immutable outputs and a safe RRD. Fault cases and representative long-input memory/scratch/runtime limits are demonstrated.

milestones.name: M3 · Internal review and customer inspection
milestones.exitGate: Pipeline recording details lead to all generated clips. Staff approve/assign atomically; datasets contain approved clips only. Authorized customers use the same real viewer without internal data or mutation access.

milestones.name: M4 · Bounded cloud CPU canary
milestones.exitGate: The same contracts run on Render, R2 and Modal CPU. Real provider failure recovery, direct transfers, measured cost/resource limits, monitoring and an isolated database restore pass.

milestones.name: M5 · Collection pilot ready
milestones.exitGate: A signed physical-device two-hour capture/upload/process/review flow meets documented limits and repair-footage usefulness criteria. Internal and customer UAT, permission/retention decisions and rollout/rollback evidence are recorded.

issues.title: Migrate the mobile recorder and SDK into the monorepo safely
issues.goal: Make the full product reproducible from one repository without disrupting the active recording fixes.
issues.scope: Coordinate a source-revision handoff; import Flutter, native plugin and SDK into the agreed target paths while preserving package boundaries.
acceptanceCriteria: Record the recording-fix handoff revision and preserve its changes; do not move an actively changing checkout without coordination.
A clean clone contains apps/mobile, packages/stera_recorder and packages/stera-sdk without required submodules.
Existing meaningful native/Flutter capture and SDK regression checks pass; licenses, fixtures and build instructions remain available.
issues.validation: Attach source revisions, migration diff and clean-clone/mobile/native build results.

issues.title: Scaffold the TypeScript and Python packages with repeatable CI
issues.goal: Provide the smallest buildable Node.js/TypeScript and Python application skeleton.
issues.scope: Create apps/web, apps/jobs, packages/server, packages/contracts and workers/processing; pin Node 24, pnpm, Python/uv and lockfiles.
acceptanceCriteria: Web, controller and Python packages have independent build/typecheck entrypoints and reviewed runtime pins.
CI validates relevant changed packages and existing mobile checks without invoking paid providers.
Server/provider dependencies and secrets cannot enter browser or mobile bundles; private local files are ignored.
issues.validation: Clean-install/build/typecheck logs and a passing CI run; no cloud resources required.

issues.title: Publish versioned API, task and artifact contracts
issues.goal: Keep phone, API, controller and processing-worker boundaries consistent.
issues.scope: Implement shared JSON schemas, public types and cross-language golden fixtures for upload, job control, manifests, frame maps and hand arrays.
acceptanceCriteria: Opaque auth IDs, UUID entity IDs, decimal-string byte sizes and integer timestamp/clock semantics match the design.
Schemas bound payload/file counts and reject changed request digests, unsupported versions and malformed pose/mask dimensions.
Node, Dart and Python load the same positive/negative fixtures; fixtures explicitly distinguish model-relative 3D from validated metric coordinates.
issues.validation: Cross-language contract fixture results, versioning policy and compatibility examples.

issues.title: Create the catalog migrations and integrity constraints
issues.goal: Make ownership, immutable clips and approved-only datasets enforceable in the data model.
issues.scope: Create nine active domain tables plus Better Auth tables, indexes and additive migrations; keep the future releases table out of the MVP.
acceptanceCriteria: Owner/client identities, unique logical files/jobs and immutable clip input/artifact references are represented with constraints and indexes.
Reviews carry revisions; dataset membership/grants support many-to-many approved-only operations under the documented lock order.
Local seed includes collector/staff/customer identities plus pending, rejected, approved, shared and private examples; concurrent write fixtures exercise integrity.
issues.validation: Migration-up results on an empty database, constraint/concurrency fixtures and query plans for bounded catalog reads.

issues.title: Run the official Render workflow runtime locally
issues.goal: Use the same task definition and provider contracts before paying for cloud execution.
issues.scope: Add local Postgres/MinIO configuration, development origins and the official Render local task server with a contract-fixture task.
acceptanceCriteria: Documented clean-clone commands register and trigger the task on the official runner at port 8120.
The runner/connectivity fixture respects API-only database/storage boundaries and shared request schemas; working reserve/sign/complete APIs are delivered by M1-06/07 and exercised by M2-09.
Phone-reachable MinIO URLs are signed for the correct origin; local/prod endpoints and secrets cannot be mixed.
issues.validation: Reproducible setup transcript, task registration/run evidence and a physical-device endpoint smoke check.

issues.title: Implement Google sign-in and server-enforced pilot access
issues.goal: Authenticate users and enforce collector, staff and customer access on every protected operation.
issues.scope: Use one Better Auth Next.js instance, operator-managed allowlist/permission evidence and explicit human/service credential boundaries.
acceptanceCriteria: Google sign-in, access-pending, disabled access and session expiry behave correctly; roles never come from client fields.
Private pages/APIs bypass shared caches; origin/CSRF checks, cookie rotation and server revocation are exercised.
Scoped workflow, cron and worker identities cannot use human endpoints, another job or broad database/storage credentials.
issues.validation: Real OAuth/session tests plus an allow/deny matrix for human and service principals.

issues.title: Build the StateAction.ai account menu and Settings
issues.goal: Provide the agreed minimal console identity controls at desktop and phone widths.
issues.scope: Use shadcn/ui with Tailwind/Radix for the responsive shell, account menu, Settings and sign-out.
acceptanceCriteria: StateAction.ai branding and role-specific navigation match the mock; no placeholder project selector or Review/Releases sidebar entries.
Only the own trimmed display name of 1–80 characters is editable; email and role remain read-only and avatar/name refresh after server success.
Confirmed sign-out clears private queries/drafts and stops playback/polling; failed revocation is retryable, and Back/direct URLs remain protected.
Keyboard/outside-click menu behavior, focus and narrow-screen layout pass; cloud jobs and collector captures are preserved.
issues.validation: Production component/browser checks and real Better Auth update/revocation evidence, not only the offline mock.

issues.title: Integrate mobile login and immutable capture ownership
issues.goal: Let authorized collectors work offline without allowing another account to adopt their captures.
issues.scope: Integrate signed-build Google authentication, secure cookie storage/rotation and owner-bound capture/upload journals.
acceptanceCriteria: Capture records the verified immutable owner when it starts; previously authorized offline capture remains possible.
Expiry/logout pauses networking while retaining captures and receipts; another account cannot browse, resume or adopt them.
Same-owner reauthentication resumes safely; legacy ownerless captures require explicit recovery and offline logout reports unconfirmed revocation.
issues.validation: Real-device Google login/expiry/account-switch tests with retained local journals and rotated cookies.

issues.title: Finalize and hash closed source files before upload
issues.goal: Never admit an incomplete, growing or silently changed MCAP as a completed source.
issues.scope: Connect native close acknowledgment, final metadata/required sidecars and bounded streaming SHA-256 to the durable journal.
acceptanceCriteria: Stop/drain/close acknowledgment precedes upload readiness; interrupted/unclosed captures remain recoverable and blocked.
File size/identity before and after hashing is stable; changed content conflicts rather than reusing the sealed identity.
MCAP, final recorder metadata and referenced required calibration sidecars are inventoried; two-hour/100 GiB transport caps are explicit.
issues.validation: Native/Flutter tests for close races, crash recovery, source mutation, required sidecars and bounded hashing buffers.

issues.title: Register recordings and seal the required-file inventory
issues.goal: Create exactly one eligible processing job after all required inputs are complete.
issues.scope: Implement recording/file registration, scoped idempotency, immutable inventory seal and the common upload-eligibility transaction.
acceptanceCriteria: Identical owner-scoped client IDs/digests replay safely; changed identities/content return conflict.
Seal and final-file completion may arrive in either order; concurrent calls create one queued job only after every required input is uploaded.
Missing/revoked collection/processing permission blocks admission; DB failures leave recoverable state and no untracked upload.
issues.validation: Database race/failure fixtures for seal, missing sidecars, final completion and duplicate registration.

issues.title: Implement shared multipart reservation, signing and receipts
issues.goal: Transfer large sources and worker outputs directly without proxying video through Next.js.
issues.scope: Build the common source/output transport service with server-selected keys, 64 MiB part plans, bounded signing and journaled ETags.
acceptanceCriteria: Reserve a file/key before provider initialization; provider IDs are persisted before any URLs are returned.
Part numbers, offsets, lengths, roles, count/byte caps and expected transport epoch are server-validated; even small outputs use multipart.
Phone/worker credentials cannot choose arbitrary keys or obtain broad write access; exact receipts are idempotent and bounded.
issues.validation: MinIO transport/authorization tests, bounded request fixtures and proof the API handles JSON rather than video bytes.

issues.title: Reconcile uncertain multipart completion and transport restart
issues.goal: Recover lost responses and expired unfinished transfers without duplicate objects or reopened files.
issues.scope: Implement fully paginated provider reconciliation, exact completion/HEAD checks, cancellation and transport-epoch restart.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify the frozen complete part set, lengths and ETags across more than 1,000 parts; ETags never substitute for SHA-256.
Lost create/complete responses or DB writes are reconciled for the exact key/MPU; ambiguous state blocks blind retry.
Only a proven retired unfinished transport can advance epoch/key; stale requests fail and completed/sealed objects cannot reopen.
Seven-day restart retains logical file/hash/owner but discards old receipts and discloses full retransmission.
issues.validation: Fault fixtures for provider success/DB failure, completion-in-flight races, stale epochs, pagination and cancellation.

issues.title: Implement the owner-bound Flutter resumable uploader
issues.goal: Resume direct uploads from durable receipts after app or network interruption.
issues.scope: Upload one source with at most two concurrent PUTs; use bounded chunk files and the shared reconcile/sign/complete protocol.
acceptanceCriteria: App kill/backgrounding/network loss preserves IDs, parts and source ownership; provider reconciliation resumes missing bytes only.
Session expiry, part URL expiry and expired MPU are distinct: same-owner login, missing URL renewal or explicit full restart respectively.
At most two active 64 MiB chunks plus one reserve exist; no whole-source duplicate or proxy upload is introduced.
issues.validation: Flutter transport fault tests and a physical-device interrupted multipart upload with byte/receipt evidence.

issues.title: Complete collector recovery states and verified local cleanup
issues.goal: Make collection recoverable without deleting valuable source data.
issues.scope: Implement the agreed Flutter status/error/recovery screens and explicit cleanup of a verified device original.
acceptanceCriteria: Camera denial, low disk, interrupted capture, finalizing, upload/auth/URL/transport expiry and wrong-owner states have actionable recovery.
Uploaded, source verified, processing complete and human approved remain distinct; no invented success state.
Only the original owner may explicitly confirm local deletion after source hash verification and staff-confirmed cloud copy; pending/failed originals are never auto-purged.
issues.validation: Real-device scenario checklist with retained journals/files and an explicit verified-copy deletion test.

issues.title: Prove CPU hand overlays and real Rerun playback early
issues.goal: Reduce the main model/viewer risk before building the full pipeline.
issues.scope: Run a short representative repair MCAP through the pinned MediaPipe asset and matching Rerun SDK/viewer in an isolated local probe.
acceptanceCriteria: Record exact model hash/license/card and environment; use real inference rather than a stub.
Inspect image-space alignment, missing-hand clearing and explicitly labelled model-relative 3D on tool/occlusion/glove examples.
A real bounded RRD loads in the proposed browser viewer; record bytes, startup/memory and limitations, and define the pilot hand-usefulness rubric/thresholds for staff agreement.
Failed usefulness or viewer qualification is reported as a blocking finding; do not substitute RGB-only or silently upgrade to a restricted GPU model.
issues.validation: Short real-input receipt, browser evidence, pinned assets/notices and an explicit quality decision/rubric.

issues.title: Implement durable job admission and worker claims
issues.goal: Admit one intentional execution and reject duplicates before expensive media work.
issues.scope: Implement jobs state, permanent input identity/deadlines, serialized global admission, controller leases and worker-scoped capabilities.
acceptanceCriteria: Persist dispatch/submission intent before external effects; queued jobs hold no idle controller and at most one processing execution is admitted.
Fresh physical worker nonce and actual execution ID claim before reading media; duplicate physical executions exit without work.
Stale/cancelled jobs, wrong capabilities and expired absolute deadlines cannot mutate current results or obtain output writes.
issues.validation: Database concurrency/state-machine fixtures and duplicate/stale claim tests.

issues.title: Run the processing controller with LocalExecutor
issues.goal: Execute the production task definition locally without duplicating orchestration logic.
issues.scope: Register process-recording in the official TypeScript Render SDK; implement bounded controller polling and LocalExecutor over the shared Python CLI.
acceptanceCriteria: Controller retries recover authoritative API state and the same known execution; a lost acknowledgement never blindly spawns again.
Use documented task metadata, lease renewal, fixed deadlines and finite limits; waiting RAM is accounted for rather than assuming suspended sleep.
Pass bootstrap privately with argv/stdin or protected files, not logged shell interpolation; uncertain local child/PID identity requires operator recovery.
issues.validation: Official local-runner integration with controller restart, runner loss, known execution and uncertain local-child cases.

issues.title: Add dispatch repair, cancellation and safe operator recovery
issues.goal: Recover missed dispatch and stuck execution without launching duplicate paid work.
issues.scope: Implement the finite repair entrypoint, scoped reconciliation APIs and manual cancel/retry/re-upload operations.
acceptanceCriteria: A bounded minute repair pass starts due/uncertain controller dispatch through the API and exits; it has no DB, Render-start or Modal credentials.
Cancel does not mean stopped; retry is available only after authoritative termination, and creates a new job/output prefix.
Unknown spawn acknowledgment remains visible and blocks blind resubmission; failed source hashes request corrected source, not a same-bytes retry.
issues.validation: Lost-dispatch, exhausted-controller, cancel/retry ordering and stale-current-job fixtures plus operator instructions.

issues.title: Seal worker outputs and atomically accept immutable clips
issues.goal: Make accepted clip evidence stable and prevent writes after completion.
issues.scope: Expose job-scoped common multipart output routes, close the inventory and reconcile candidate manifests with terminal/current execution state.
acceptanceCriteria: Only the current claimed job may allocate/complete permitted bounded outputs; the API consumes multipart IDs and closes further writes.
Acceptance verifies finalized inventory identity/hash/counts, sealed source references and known worker termination; callbacks alone are provisional.
One transaction registers immutable clips/artifacts; late, stale, cancelled, corrupt or duplicate results cannot replace a selected result.
issues.validation: Output write-after-seal, old capability, late callback, manifest mismatch and atomic acceptance fixtures.

issues.title: Stream MCAP and decode frames with bounded memory
issues.goal: Read each raw recording once per attempt while preserving native evidence.
issues.scope: Implement a non-seeking hash-wrapped MCAP reader, bounded decompression/record/frame queues and native clock/raster association.
acceptanceCriteria: Use file-order non-seeking iteration and consume/hash all source bytes including the footer; no full raw source staging or whole-session arrays.
Bound record sizes, decompression, image dimensions, join windows and encoder queues; reject unsupported ordering/clock associations explicitly.
Decode each RGB frame once for inference and encoders; preserve native event/timestamps, available sensor evidence and all raster/crop/rotation/mirror transforms.
issues.validation: Corrupt/oversized/clock/raster fixtures with source-read counts and peak buffer measurements.

issues.title: Implement mandatory 21-landmark CPU hand inference
issues.goal: Produce the agreed hand observations without overstating accuracy or missingness.
issues.scope: Add the pinned MediaPipe CPU model adapter to the streaming processor with deterministic joint/coordinate/provenance contracts.
acceptanceCriteria: Return up to two hands with 21 native-image landmarks, raw model-relative 3D estimates, declared conventions and exact frame mappings.
Detection/finite masks and unsupported confidence/visibility semantics are explicit; handedness score is never labelled per-joint confidence.
No-hand frames are legitimate masked output; model errors fail the job and cannot yield successful RGB-only output; metric_accuracy_validated stays false.
issues.validation: Model/coordinate/missingness fixtures and representative real repair overlays against the agreed usefulness rubric.

issues.title: Write bounded clip artifacts and a portable reader
issues.goal: Produce reusable immutable clips and customer-safe review payloads.
issues.scope: Write native RGB MP4, NPZ arrays, frame-map rows, available sensor evidence, thumbnails, safe RRD and versioned manifests through the output protocol.
acceptanceCriteria: Progressively close/upload shards rather than retain a whole recording; retry output prefixes cannot overwrite prior artifacts.
Start with <=60-second clips and the proposed <=128 MiB RRD / 1280x720 proxy limits; shorten clips if needed while preserving native cadence and explicit transforms.
The customer-safe RRD contains no raw MCAP, internal notes/QC or unrelated clip data; hiding entities is not authorization.
A documented Python reader round-trips poses, masks, timestamps and provenance against the exact manifest; no Lance dependency.
issues.validation: Real emitted artifacts/reader checksums, source-to-preview frame comparison and inspected safe RRD contents/bytes.

issues.title: Persist inline quality checks and reject corrupt candidates
issues.goal: Expose structural processing evidence while withholding failed or unverified results.
issues.scope: Implement final source hashes, decode/dimension/frame-map/array/mask/output checks and bounded machine-readable check summaries.
acceptanceCriteria: Final source mismatch rejects the entire candidate even when inference already ran; no source is marked verified before EOF.
Check status distinguishes pass/warn/fail/measured/not_evaluated with counts/reasons; coverage is measured, not accuracy.
All writes complete and the bounded manifest/inventory closes before reporting; failures retain actionable job diagnostics without accepting clips.
issues.validation: Injected corrupt hashes, decode errors, missing frames/hands, nonfinite arrays and interrupted output fixtures.

issues.title: Qualify local end-to-end recovery and long-input bounds
issues.goal: Prove the real CPU pipeline before activating cloud processing.
issues.scope: Run the official local workflow path from real phone upload to accepted clips, then progressively longer/faulted inputs including the two-hour target.
acceptanceCriteria: The same API/transport/task/worker contracts complete a short real MCAP with mandatory hand inference and reader validation.
Record peak RAM/scratch, source/output/RRD bytes, source-read count and wall time for a representative two-hour input; limits are enforced rather than inferred from upload caps.
Lost acknowledgements, duplicate workers, runner loss, cancellation, stale results and partial writes preserve admission, immutable outputs and visible errors.
Stub protocol tests are labelled separately and cannot satisfy real-model acceptance; no cloud GPU/provider is required.
issues.validation: Reproducible local qualification report with input/code/model/config hashes, resource measurements and fault outcomes.

issues.title: Build Pipeline monitoring and per-recording actions
issues.goal: Let staff locate processing failures and review the clips from one recording.
issues.scope: Implement bounded staff list/detail APIs and the compact Pipeline list, recording detail visualization and lifecycle actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Four-column searchable/status-filtered rows open /pipeline/[recordingId]; no row action buttons, Scenario selector or raw UUID/path display.
Detail alone contains source/errors, actual stage evidence and applicable Review clips/Cancel/Retry/re-upload/reconcile actions; absent telemetry stays unknown.
Upload -> Queued -> Processing -> Quality checks -> Ready for review are conceptual stages, not additional workflow tasks; source hash completes at EOF.
Review clips opens /data-browser?recordingId=<UUID> with all generated clips, no automatic reviewStatus; preserve filters/back navigation and recheck exact current-job capabilities.
issues.validation: Staff/customer route checks, lifecycle/stale-action fixtures and keyboard/desktop/phone navigation evidence.

issues.title: Implement approved-only dataset APIs and view grants
issues.goal: Organize approved clips without media copies and expose only authorized data.
issues.scope: Implement bounded dataset/clip catalog reads, create/edit/member operations and operator-managed dataset_access.
acceptanceCriteria: Only latest-approved clips can be dataset members for staff and customer; direct forged pending/rejected additions fail.
One clip may be in multiple datasets or approved/unassigned; counts/hours reflect distinct currently visible approved members.
Every customer metadata/thumbnail/viewer request rechecks enabled access, live grant, membership and approval; All clips/recording-wide catalog access is forbidden.
Current recipient-sharing permission is recorded before grants or additions to shared datasets; internal notes/QC/collector details never enter customer payloads.
issues.validation: Membership, pagination/count consistency, permission-revocation and cross-customer access fixtures.

issues.title: Commit review decisions and dataset assignments atomically
issues.goal: Ensure review races cannot expose pending or rejected clips in datasets.
issues.scope: Implement append-only reviews, expected review/dataset revisions, ordered locks and atomic desired memberships.
acceptanceCriteria: Approve requires a nonblank task label and current revisions before one decision/membership transaction; optional notes/empty selection remain valid.
Blank/stale/failed assignment changes no review, membership or revision; omission preserves membership and explicit empty selection clears it.
Reject/withdraw removes every working membership and bumps affected revisions atomically; reapproval never restores memberships implicitly.
Concurrent add/approve/reject commands cannot leave partial membership or an unapproved dataset member.
issues.validation: Real Postgres concurrency/rollback fixtures with before/after review, membership and revision evidence.

issues.title: Build the shared Data browser with URL-backed filters
issues.goal: Provide one understandable dataset browser and staff recording-review catalog.
issues.scope: Implement dataset list, approved clip grid, staff All clips, approved-only add/assignment pickers and persistent query navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: Default /data-browser lists datasets with name, clip count and total hours; datasetId opens screenshot/title/task/metadata cards.
Staff view=clips includes accepted pending/rejected/unassigned clips; recordingId alone infers clip mode and shows that recording only.
Recording review has a fixed recording-name backlink to its Pipeline detail and no clear-recording button; clips preserve the return context.
Customer has only granted approved datasets; loading/empty/denied states and refresh/paste/Back/Forward work at desktop/phone widths.
issues.validation: Role-based browser navigation, URL round trips, dataset picker eligibility and responsive screenshots.

issues.title: Embed the real shared Rerun viewer safely
issues.goal: Replace the HTML/SVG stand-in with the same authorized clip viewer for staff and customers.
issues.scope: Use a client-only React adapter around pinned @rerun-io/web-viewer 0.22.1 with matching Python SDK and self-hosted JS/WASM.
acceptanceCriteria: The production Next.js build loads real bounded worker RRDs from authorized local MinIO URLs without SSR/runtime duplication or a live external Rerun server; real R2/provider qualification belongs to M4-03.
Fresh URL issuance rechecks access; safe bytes exclude staff data rather than relying on hidden entities or client role flags.
Test CORS/MIME/assets, sequential clip loads, expired URL recovery, route teardown, missing-hand clearing and persistent unsaved staff edits.
Record startup/transfer/peak browser memory and frame fidelity on supported desktop/phone browsers; 3D estimates remain quietly but clearly labelled.
issues.validation: Production build and real RRD/browser qualification report; mock screenshots alone do not pass.

issues.title: Build the shared clip review and read-only customer page
issues.goal: Let our team review each clip and customers inspect the same approved evidence.
issues.scope: Implement /clips/[clipId] with the shared viewer, staff quality checks/form and server-derived role capabilities.
acceptanceCriteria: Staff see Automatic quality checks, task label, optional notes, optional Datasets multiselect and direct Approve/Reject.
Drafts survive viewer rerenders/URL reloads; selection alone writes nothing and successful decisions rebase from saved memberships.
Customer sees approved label and safe viewer only; no staff notes/QC, review mutation or per-episode accept/reject.
No inspection acknowledgment checkbox, yellow callout, Other clips section, raw path chip or separate sidebar Review item.
issues.validation: Real API-backed approval/rejection/draft/denial/error-state browser tests and responsive screenshots.

issues.title: Prove local staff-to-customer review and isolation
issues.goal: Establish actual review/access behavior rather than prototype-only evidence.
issues.scope: Run collection -> processing -> Pipeline detail -> recording grid -> review/assignment -> granted-customer inspection through real local services.
acceptanceCriteria: Staff can approve an unassigned clip, assign to multiple datasets, reject/remove all memberships and reapprove without silent restoration.
Blank/stale/concurrent writes roll back correctly; customer catalog/hidden clips/raw data/internal fields are denied.
Grant removal, membership removal, latest-review withdrawal and disabled access deny fresh metadata/URL issuance; already issued URLs have documented expiry limits.
The same real clip URL/viewer works across roles with the latest approved label and no release/export prerequisite.
issues.validation: Recorded end-to-end fixture/input IDs, database race results, browser/API access matrix and real viewer evidence.

issues.title: Deploy the Render stack and private R2 configuration
issues.goal: Deploy the agreed application stack with explicit credential and network boundaries.
issues.scope: Add reviewed monorepo Render configuration for web, paid Postgres, the Node workflow and finite repair cron; configure private R2 bucket/keys/lifecycle/CORS before worker activation and start with ingest disabled.
acceptanceCriteria: Web alone connects to private Postgres and holds R2 signing/Render dispatch credentials; workflow/cron/worker credentials remain scoped.
Hosted controller and local runner import the same task definition; production rejects local executor/endpoint settings.
Compatible pinned builds/migrations, HTTPS/trusted origins, health checks and separated staging/production secrets are documented.

Before paid activation/canaries, record the approved budget, account spending alerts, admission/runtime/resource limits and stop conditions; no default GPU, warm worker, extra API, outbox or additional engine.
Private R2 source/output buckets, lifecycle, permitted origins and signing bindings exist before the Modal canary; no public bucket or media proxy.
issues.validation: Reviewed configuration/deploy IDs, connection/credential-boundary checks and rollback procedure; actual paid activation remains separately authorized.

issues.title: Deploy the Modal CPU executor over the shared worker
issues.goal: Switch local execution to Modal without changing business or artifact contracts.
issues.scope: Implement ModalExecutor and a finite CPU function wrapper importing the same Python processing core.
acceptanceCriteria: Image/model/code/config hashes and candidate CPU/RAM/scratch/timeout limits are pinned; concurrency is one and warm containers zero.
Persist submission intent and actual Modal function-call ID; each physical execution claims before source reads and uses only scoped read/upload capabilities.
Known calls survive controller retries; lost acknowledgements stay uncertain and never authorize automatic second submission or GPU escalation.
Controllers/worker contain no DB credentials or broad R2 write keys; local/cloud artifacts remain contract-compatible.
issues.validation: After the M4-01 budget/alert/stop-condition preflight and M2-09 local gate pass, run one explicitly bounded CPU canary with execution ID, resource/byte/cost receipt and matching local artifact reader.

issues.title: Qualify real R2 multipart and private viewer transfers
issues.goal: Verify provider semantics that MinIO cannot establish.
issues.scope: Qualify the private R2 configuration from M4-01 with bounded real phone/worker/browser transfer tests and provider-semantic fault cases.
acceptanceCriteria: Real part receipts, pagination, completion/HEAD, cancellation and uncertain response recovery preserve exact bytes and transport identity.
Completed/sealed outputs cannot be overwritten through old part URLs or stale capabilities; public listing/access is denied.
Phone uploads and browser RRD reads bypass Render; signed URL expiration/renewal and CORS/ETag behavior pass.
issues.validation: Recorded object/file IDs, source/output checksums, provider faults and measured transferred bytes; no real customer data required.

issues.title: Prove cloud workflow and worker failure recovery
issues.goal: Demonstrate that uncertain cloud outcomes cannot duplicate processing or corrupt accepted data.
issues.scope: Run a finite staging fault matrix against real Render/Modal/R2 using synthetic or permission-cleared short captures.
acceptanceCriteria: Inject lost Render/Modal acknowledgements, controller retry/exhaustion, duplicate physical worker claims and late callbacks.
Cancellation/timeouts retain admission until termination is known; manual retry uses a new job/prefix and never replaces old immutable clips.
Output allocation/completion after seal or stale/cancelled results are rejected; uncertain executions require the documented operator reconciliation.
Record each intentional execution and its gross cost; stop after the agreed bounded canary budget.
issues.validation: Provider execution IDs and before/after job/file state for every fault; no automatic expensive test loop.

issues.title: Instrument pipeline resources, errors and spending
issues.goal: Operate a low-budget pilot with measured limits and actionable failures.
issues.scope: Add structured stage/job metrics, bounded logs, admission limits, cost accounting, queue/uncertainty/error alerts and retention configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: Record startup/wall time, peak RAM/scratch, source/output/RRD bytes, inline QC and provider execution IDs without cookies/tokens/signed queries.
No invented progress: unknown telemetry is visible; alerts cover delayed queued jobs, uncertain/stuck execution, source hash failures and spending.
Admission/runtime/concurrency limits and provider alerts are configured; alerts are not described as billing hard caps.
Report fixed platform floor and measured per-input/worker/transfer/storage usage separately; verify zero unnecessary warm workers.
issues.validation: Sample operator view/logs, triggered alert tests and one gross-cost/resource receipt with documented assumptions.

issues.title: Test database restore and document operational recovery
issues.goal: Recover catalog state without restarting uncertain work or restoring revoked access.
issues.scope: Exercise managed Postgres backup/restore into isolation and document deployment rollback, external-state reconciliation and data retention.
acceptanceCriteria: Restore a representative catalog and verify referenced private objects/checksums without modifying the live database.
Keep ingest/dispatch disabled until external jobs/uploads and revoked sessions/grants are reconciled.
Document actual restore window/gaps, recovery steps and measured restore time; DB recovery does not claim to restore deleted R2 payloads.
Rollback preserves sources and accepted artifacts; referenced/published data is never age-purged as scratch.
issues.validation: Restore drill receipt, checked runbook and source/catalog consistency evidence.

issues.title: Prepare collector permissions, retention and support runbooks
issues.goal: Admit only the intended collectors and external reviewers with clear retention/support decisions.
issues.scope: Record pilot collection/processing/external-inspection permission evidence, allowlist/grant procedures, retention and owner-assisted recovery instructions.
acceptanceCriteria: Operators can enable/revoke immutable user IDs and dataset grants with recorded permission evidence; no self-service sharing/admin UI is introduced.
Collector instructions distinguish capture finalization, upload completion, verification, review and explicit local cleanup.
Retention/low-disk/support/incident actions name responsible roles and recording/job references; no automatic deletion of pending or failed originals.
issues.validation: Reviewed permission/retention decisions and operator dry run with test collector/staff/customer accounts.

issues.title: Qualify a signed-device two-hour capture through cloud review
issues.goal: Validate the actual field-sized workload and required hand usefulness before inviting repair workers.
issues.scope: Run a representative signed-phone two-hour capture with interruption/resume, cloud CPU processing, real clip review and independent hand-overlay assessment.
acceptanceCriteria: Record device/build, source/code/image/model/config versions; confirm login/background/app-kill recovery and unchanged original owner.
Measure upload and processing time, native/preview frame mapping, source/output bytes, peak resources and gross cloud cost against the enforced limits.
Evaluate tools/gloves/occlusion, missing hands, handedness and overlay accuracy against the agreed rubric; document failures and block rollout if usefulness is inadequate.
All accepted clips load in the real viewer with explicit 3D-estimate limitations; no verified metric/action/training-quality claim is implied.
issues.validation: One permission-cleared long-capture receipt, reviewer observations, resource/cost report and explicit pass/fail against the agreed rubric.

issues.title: Complete internal and customer UAT and pilot go/no-go
issues.goal: Release the collection/review pilot only after all milestone evidence is reviewable.
issues.scope: Run the final collector/staff/customer acceptance script and record accountable sign-off, known limitations and rollback readiness.
acceptanceCriteria: Collector completes recovery-aware upload; staff uses Pipeline -> recording clips -> shared review, approves/assigns, and observes automatic QC.
A separately authenticated customer browses only granted approved datasets and inspects the same clip read-only; forged private routes/mutations are denied.
All milestone gates link reproducible evidence; unresolved launch blockers, owners and mitigations are explicit before the project is marked complete.
Rollout/cost/admission limits and incident/rollback responsibilities are confirmed; dataset export/download, GPU and Curator/Lance stay outside MVP completion.
issues.validation: Completed UAT script, separate-role access evidence, go/no-go decision and linked known limitations; screenshots alone are insufficient.
